name: Albatross Ringer

intro.text: I put rings on albatrosses for a living. Wingspan three and a half metres. Mood: furious. You'll be fine.

win: Ouch. I've had worse from a wandering albatross, but not by much.
after: A wandering albatross can go round the world in about a year. I can't get to the shop in less.
